scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --outdir public --minify && bun build worker.ts --outfile public/worker.js --minify
scripts.dev: concurrently "bun build src/main.ts --outdir public --watch" "bun build worker.ts --outfile public/worker.js --watch" "tsc --noEmit --watch" "bun x serve public"
scripts.start: bun run build; bun x serve public
